title: Add proptest dependency and CRDT property test: merge commutativity
description:
Add proptest to core dev-dependencies. Write a proptest that generates two arbitrary diverged group logs (arbitrary entry sets, arbitrary tip sets) and asserts that reconcile(A,B) and reconcile(B,A) produce symmetric want/have sets (commutativity). Artifact: crates/core/tests/crdt_properties.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Property test runs with cargo test
- 1000 random cases checked per run
- Any case where commutativity fails is a P0 bug
- Test is deterministic with a fixed seed for reproduction
